subject: English
title: English 7 (PECTAA, SNC 2022)
questions: On which date did Hazrat Muhammad (PBUH) deliver his Last Sermon?
He delivered the Last Sermon on the ninth of Dhul Hijjah, 10 years after Hijrat.
Where was the Last Sermon delivered?
It was delivered in the Uranah valley of Mount Arafat.
In which year after Hijrat was the Last Sermon delivered?
It was delivered 10 years after Hijrat.
In the Last Sermon, what did the Holy Prophet (PBUH) declare sacred?
Life, property and honour of every Muslim
He said your blood, property and honour are as sacred as this day, this month and this city.
What did the Holy Prophet (PBUH) say about usury (riba)?
'Usury is forbidden' — he began by remitting the interest due to Abbas bin Abdul-Muttalib.
Whose interest claims did the Prophet (PBUH) remit first?
He remitted entirely the interest Abbas bin Abdul-Muttalib had to receive.
Regarding women, the Holy Prophet (PBUH) said:
'O people! Fear Allah concerning women' — he stressed their rights.
The Last Sermon told Muslims to worship Allah, offer five prayers, fast in Ramadan and:
He recommended five prayers, fasting in Ramadan and paying Zakat.
Major Tufail Muhammad was given the task of retrieving which village?
He was assigned to retrieve the village Lakshmipur in East Pakistan from Indian occupation.
When did Major Tufail Muhammad embrace martyrdom?
Into how many groups did Major Tufail divide his men?
He divided his men into three groups.
Rashid Minhas was the only officer of which force to receive the Nishan-e-Haider?
Rashid Minhas was the only PAF officer to receive the Nishan-e-Haider.
Rashid Minhas is the youngest person to receive the:
He was the youngest and shortest-serving officer to receive the Nishan-e-Haider.
On which date did Rashid Minhas's training flight incident happen?
On August 20, 1971, his instructor tried to seize control of the aircraft.
Where did Rashid Minhas join as a flying cadet?
At 17 he joined the Pakistan Air Force Academy in Risalpur as a flying cadet.
According to the poem 'A Nation's Strength', what does NOT make a nation strong?
'It is not gold' — kingdoms built on gold go down in battle shock.
In the poem, kingdoms built on gold have their shafts laid on:
'Its shafts are laid on sinking sand, not on abiding rock.'
What does the poet say about the sword?
Empires built on it passed away into red dust
'Ask the red dust of empires passed away' — the sword did not keep empires alive.
Who builds a nation's pillars deep, according to the poem?
Men who work while others sleep
'Brave men who work while others sleep, who dare while others fly, they build a nation's pillars deep.'
The central idea of 'A Nation's Strength' is that a nation's true strength lies in:
Not gold, sword or pride, but men of truth and honour make a nation strong.
The glossary defines throng as a large, densely packed crowd of people.
When and where was Quaid-e-Azam born?
Muhammad Ali Jinnah was born on December 25, 1876 in Karachi.
Why was Muhammad Ali Jinnah called Quaid-e-Azam?
For his far-sightedness and leadership qualities
He was known as Quaid-e-Azam because of his far-sightedness and leadership qualities.
In his early politics, Jinnah was a proponent of:
In the early days of his politics he was a proponent of Hindu-Muslim unity.
In which year did the Congress agree to a separate electorate after the Lucknow Pact?
The Congress agreed to a separate electorate for the first time in 1916, after the Lucknow Pact.
Quaid-e-Azam's Fourteen Points were presented in reaction to:
The famous Fourteen Points were introduced in reaction to the Nehru Report.
Where were the Round Table Conferences held (1930-32)?
The Round Table Conferences were held in London from 1930 to 1932.
The idea that Hindus and Muslims are two separate nations is called the:
Quaid-e-Azam was well aware of the Two-Nation Theory: Hindus and Muslims are two nations.
The word smog was coined from a mixture of smoke and fog.
In which months does smog slow down everything in Punjab?
During December and January smog slows down everything.
Which province of Pakistan is most affected by smog?
Punjab is the most affected out of all provinces.
Which city, once called the city of gardens, has been named one of the most polluted cities?
Lahore, the provincial capital, has been called one of the most polluted cities in the world.
Why has the problem of smog intensified in recent decades?
Rapid industrialisation and thousands of vehicles have intensified the problem.
Smog particles cause diseases including asthma, strokes, heart attacks and lung cancer.
According to the lesson, poor air quality results in:
The better the air quality, the better our mental health; poor air quality harms it.
Samina Baig is the first Pakistani woman to reach the top of which peak (2nd highest in the world)?
She reached the top of the 8611-metre K2, the 2nd highest peak in the world.
In which year did Samina Baig climb Mount Everest?
In 2013 Samina became the first Pakistani woman to climb Mount Everest.
Who trained Samina Baig in mountaineering?
She was trained in mountaineering by her brother Mirza Ali.
How many summits on seven continents did Samina Baig scale?
She is the only Pakistani woman to scale the seven summits on seven continents, in eight months.
Aconcagua, climbed by Samina Baig, is the highest peak in:
Aconcagua in Argentina is the highest peak in South America.
Mount Kilimanjaro is the highest peak in:
Mount Kilimanjaro in Tanzania is the highest peak in Africa.
Why did Mirza Ali let his sister reach the Everest summit alone?
To present a message of empowerment to the women of Pakistan
He stopped short to present a message of empowerment to all women of Pakistan.
The word 'Adha' is an Arabic word meaning:
Adha is an Arabic word for sacrifice.
What did Allah send instead of Hazrat Ismail (AS) to be sacrificed?
Allah sent the angel Jibrail with a ram to sacrifice instead of his son.
Who tried to stop Hazrat Ibrahim (AS) from obeying Allah's command?
Satan attempted to confuse and tempt Hazrat Ibrahim, but he drove him away.
About how long after Eid-ul-Fitr does Eid-ul-Adha come?
Eid-ul-Adha takes place about two months after Eid-ul-Fitr.
How is the meat of the sacrificial animal divided?
Equally among family, friends and the needy
The meat is divided equally among family, friends and the needy.
Which two children ask their parents questions about Eid-ul-Adha?
Zainab and Saliha ask their parents different questions about the festival.
In which country is 'The Wise Old Woman' set?
The story is set in a small village in the western hills of Japan.
What was the cruel lord's decree?
Anyone over seventy-one must be left in the mountains
Anyone over seventy-one was to be banished and left in the mountains to die.
Why did the old mother break off twigs on the way up the mountain?
To mark the way so her son would not get lost
She said she was marking the way so her son would not get lost returning.
Where did the farmer hide his mother?
In a secret room dug under the kitchen floor
He dug a deep hole in the kitchen floor and made a small room to hide her.
Which lord threatened to conquer the village?
Lord Higa of the town beyond the hills threatened to take the village.
How did the old woman make a drum that sounds without being beaten?
Put a bumblebee inside a paper drum
Make a drum with paper sides and put a bumblebee inside; as it tries to escape it beats the sides.
What did the young lord realise at the end?
He had been very wrong; the old are wise
He said, 'I have been very wrong' and learned that the old woman was wiser than all his wise men.
Who wrote the poem 'Think Not All is Over'?
The poem is by Harriet Stowe.
What returns after autumn, according to the poem?
'Think not all is over, spring returneth; buds and leaves and blossoms thou shalt see.'
What sleeps in the frozen buds of every winter?
The blossoms of a future flower
'In the frozen buds of every winter sleep the blossoms of a future flower.'
'For a night alone endureth, God at last shall bring a ___ hour.'
Night does not last; God at last shall bring a morning hour.
The main message of 'Think Not All is Over' is:
Never lose hope; bad times pass
The poem teaches hope: after hardship, good times return.
crying with pain, grief or anger
The glossary gives wailing as crying with pain, grief or anger.
What was the name of the boy's father's business?
His father owned the Glenn Plumbing Company.
What was the boy called by his family?
His father asked, 'You want to go up, Bud?'
How old was the boy when he first flew in a plane?
It was the summer he turned eight.
What kind of plane did they fly in?
A man had an old open-cockpit biplane and was taking people up.
Which famous pilot had crossed the Atlantic Ocean two years earlier?
Everybody knew about Charles Lindbergh's Atlantic crossing flight two years earlier.
How did the boy feel after the flight?
When he got out of the plane he was elated.
From the air, the buildings looked like:
a toy train set in a store
Everything on the ground looked small, like a train set in a store.
According to Allama Iqbal, culture encompasses all the:
mental, spiritual and physical activities of a nation
Iqbal said culture encompasses all the mental, spiritual and physical activities of a nation.
Pakistani culture is mainly inspired by:
Pakistan is an ideological Islamic state, and its culture is inspired by Islam.
About what percentage of Pakistanis speak Punjabi as a first language, according to the lesson?
Punjabi is spoken as a first language by 44% of Pakistanis.
Phulkari is associated with the costumes of:
Punjab is known for the use of phulkari in its costumes.
Which is a traditional Punjabi dish mentioned in the lesson?
Sarson ka saag and makai ki roti
Dishes exclusive to Punjab include parathas, makai ki roti and sarson ka saag.
Which sports are Punjabis especially fond of, according to the lesson?
Punjabi people are fond of kabaddi and wrestling.
Media is known as the ___ pillar of democracy.
Media is known as the fourth pillar of democracy.
Media is considered the ___ of modern society.
Media is considered the mirror of modern society.
Where do newspapers usually publish public opinion?
Public opinion is reflected in letters to the editor, published on a separate page.
Electronic media was born with the invention of the:
The birth of electronic media took place with the invention of the radio.
Which of these is a social media network named in the lesson?
Facebook, YouTube, Twitter and Instagram are named as social media networks.
Print media provides great incentive to business through:
Print media helps business through a large number of advertisements.
